content: OṂ VAJRA BHŪMI ĀḤ HŪṂ, the perfectly pure, mighty golden ground. OṂ VAJRA REKHE ĀḤ HŪṂ, in the center, surrounded by the iron mountain wall, is HŪṂ, the king of mountains, Mount Meru; the eastern continent Pūrvavideha, the southern Jambudvīpa, the western Aparagodānīya, and the northern Uttarakuru; the sub-continents Deha and Videha, Cāmara and Aparacāmara, Śaṭhā and Uttaramantriṇa, and Kurava and Kaurava; the mountain of jewels, the wish-fulfilling tree, the wish-granting cow, the unsown harvest, the precious wheel, the precious jewel, the precious queen, the precious minister, the precious elephant, the precious horse, the precious general, and the great treasure vase; the goddess of beauty, the goddess of garlands, the goddess of song, the goddess of dance, the goddess of incense, the goddess of flowers, the goddess of lamps, and the goddess of perfume; the sun, the moon, the precious parasol, and the banner of victory in all directions. This entire collection of the perfect and complete wealth of gods and humans, lacking nothing, I offer to the glorious, holy root and lineage gurus, the assembly of yidam mandala deities, the Buddhas, the Bodhisattvas, the protectors of the sublime Dharma, and the assembly of yaksha wealth deities. Out of compassion, please accept these for the sake of beings. Having accepted them, please grant your blessings.And so, then:With clouds of offerings of every kind, as numerous as the atoms of an ocean of buddha-fields,Upon the crest of light radiating in the ten directions from the ornaments that adorn them,Within the essence of precious lotuses that emit precious light and bloom in every way, as numerous as the atoms of an ocean,Where these wondrous sensory pleasures of gods and humans, sources of all desired glory, are perfectly established in a hundred million ways,This cloud of offerings, emanated by a thoroughly virtuous mind just like the manifestations of Samantabhadra,Pervades the entire expanse of space just like the dharmadhātu, and remains for as long as the realm of sentient beings exists,So that, established there, the King of Dharma, the Victors, the Bodhisattvas, the Pratyekabuddhas, and those who have conquered the enemy,May be pleased by all these offerings presented in every mandala that surrounds them on all sides.From this moment until I reach the heart of enlightenment,My body, my possessions,And all virtuous things of the three times,For the sake of the benefit of all sentient beings,I respectfully offer to you.You who possess the eyes that see in every way,O sublime objects of veneration,Please regard me with your loving compassion,And I pray you to accept these offerings of mine.Having accepted them, please grant your blessings.OṂ GURU BUDDHA BODHISATTVA SAPARIVĀRA RATNA MAṆḌALA PŪJĀ MEGHA SAMUDRA SPHARAṆA SAMAYA HŪṂThe ground is anointed with incense and strewn with flowers,Adorned with Mount Meru, the four continents, the sun, and the moon.Visualizing this as a buddha-field, I offer it;May all beings enjoy the completely pure realm.IDAM GURU RATNA MAṆḌALAKAṂ NIRYĀTAYĀMI
